findings.claim: Order creation mixes HTTP response shaping, business rules, persistence-state mutation, audit logging and email side effects in one module.
The application entry point and order module form a direct circular CommonJS dependency.
Shared mutable in-memory state is mutated from order workflows, making state ownership and test isolation weak.
The fixture explicitly has no automated test suite, so behavior-preserving refactoring needs characterization coverage first.

evidence.anchor: No automated test suite is configured.
